'''Banana trees''' are one of the many genera of trees found above ground in tropical biomes. Unlike most trees, it produces no wood (''owing to the fact that this 'tree' is in truth an [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musa_(genus) overstated] [[shrub]]''), though it does produce a well-known [[fruit]] which can be eaten raw, cooked, or brewed into [[alcohol|banana beer]]. As these fruit have seeds, they are likely the lesser known [[wikipedia:wild banana|wild banana]].

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] banana trees for their ''fruit''.


[[File:Banana Tree 01.jpg|thumb|center|300px|Admired for its ''fruit''.]]

{{D for Dwarf}}

Banana peels are especially dangerous to [[Wagon|wagons]] and are sometimes seen trailing behind them.
